docs: Single source of truth for which ZFS branches are built and
published against which TrueNAS kernels, read by ci.yml (native
deb build + rolling release), kernel-watch.yml (rebuild when the
kernel moves) and zfs-qemu-tn.yml (functional tests under the
TrueNAS kernel).  Each trains[] entry pairs a ZFS branch with the
rolling kernel release it is built against (kernel_repo +
kernel_tag); the resulting debs are republished as this repo's
<train>-nightly release.  Branches not listed here build and test
against the default_train pairing and publish nothing.
Each branch builds and publishes from its own copy of this file,
and kernel-watch reads every pairing back from that copy; it uses
the copy on the default branch only for the list of branches to
watch.  A branch that does not carry this file yet is reported as
Every branch and every train may appear at most once, or two
builds would fight over one release; scripts/resolve-train.py
enforces that, along with the required fields and their shapes,
